card.name: Terror Scythe Goku Black
card.skill: [Auto] When you play this card, play 2 Shadow tokens. (Shadow tokens have 10000 power, 0 combo costs, and 5000 combo power) Then, you may choose 1 <Zamasu> from your deck and add it to your hand. If you do so, choose 1 card in your hand and place it in the Drop Area. Then, shuffle your deck.

qa.q: You activated a skill that allows you to search through your deck. As part of resolving that skill, can you take a thorough look at the cards in your deck and confirm what cards are in your deck and Life Area?
qa.a:
No, you cannot.
Resolve the skill as quickly as possible, and do not look at other cards unless absolutely necessary.

qa.q: Do you need to reveal the card you added to your hand with this card ‘s auto skill?
Can a Shadow token be KO-ed by skills that KO Battle Cards with energy costs of 3 or less.
qa.a: No, you can’t. Unless otherwise specified, tokens don’t have an energy cost, and can’t be chosen by skills that reference energy costs.
